defect.evidence: Reproduced: printf '{not valid json' > /tmp/bad_registry.json; python3 tools/archivist_bug_admission.py --run-id t --repository f/b --base-sha x --registry /tmp/bad_registry.json --output /tmp/out.json raises an uncaught json.decoder.JSONDecodeError, exits 1, and writes no receipt file at all -- even though .github/workflows/sentinel-routines.yml invokes this exact step with if: always() specifically to guarantee a durable receipt is always preserved. Bundled in the same fix: normalize_candidate() checked required-field presence on raw (pre-normalization) values, so whitespace-only fields like '   ' passed the presence check and were then normalized down to empty strings, letting a content-free candidate be admitted.
defect.normalized_root_cause: json.loads called without exception handling, crashing before any receipt is written
defect.trigger: malformed or unreadable json in the registry, open-prs, or candidate input file
